nodes.author: MetropolisLab
nodes.text: With a few cases of #HumanMetapneumovirus (HMPV) infections recently reported in certain states across India, concerns are rising due to similarities with the respiratory illness outbreak in China. However, it’s important to note that HMPV is not a new threat.

nodes.author: MetropolisLab
nodes.text: First identified in 2001, this virus has been circulating globally for decades as a common respiratory pathogen. While vigilance is essential, there’s no need for undue alarm.

nodes.author: MetropolisLab
nodes.text: Stay informed as Dr Niranjan sheds light on this respiratory virus and how diagnostics can aid in timely detection and better health outcomes.
